positions.insights: Skills: Oracle SQL Developer · PL/SQL · Teradata SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: Database Developer/Data Analyst
positions.description:
Supported and developed custom scripts in Oracle (PL/SQL) for the creation of reports in Hyperion and Excel (VBA)
global supply chain and capacity planning solutions. 
. Developed a supply review system in Oracle (procedures, functions, materialized views) 
to assist the capacity planning team assist in the forecasting of the demand, capacity and 
inventory supply for multiple sites worldwide. 
. Supported and created reports in Perl for a MySQL\Linux based server that assisted 
business users and program managers to keep track of orders, trends and capacity at 
multiple stages of the supply chain. This consisted of pulling data from multiple oracle 
servers and instances to calculate and produce a final set of information for the users to 
view. 
. Developed Excel (VBA) based application to assist in the separation of customer 
orders (demand) into multiple factories according to a set of constantly changing rules. 
. Created Hyperion based reports for easier access of data to the results of a weekly run 
data set that provided multiple scenarios in regards to factory capacity at different 
stages of the supply chain.

positions.title: Lead Analyst
positions.description:
. Responsible for developing complex queries to extract information required from 
different internal departments (payroll, customer service, auditing, HR, and others).
. Responsible for the research and development of PL/SQL scripts to clean historical and 
unnecessary data due to space constraints. 
. Responsible for developing custom features in Java, including pension export and 
attendance report. 
. Support 25,000 users in over 150 stations by determining workarounds or developing 
fixes with the completion of issues in bug tracker system. 
. Technologies used include Java Server Pages (JSP), tag libraries, Java Database
Connectivity (JDBC), Oracle SQLDeveloper, Oracle 10g database, Red Hat Linux based app servers, Oracle Containers for Java (OC4J) and NetBeans IDE.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
. Develop production support tools in Visual FoxPro and Visual Basic for Level I and 
other Level II teams to help reduce escalations as well as increase SLA’s for first call 
resolution. This tool creation consists of the complete development life cycle including 
proposals, approvals, programming, testing, peer testing, and documentation. 
. Support 18,000 users in over 1600 branches by determining workarounds or fixes with 
the completion of tickets in the Remedy queue, and warm transferred calls 
. Analyze loan files by creating effective queries and searches though FoxPro syntax or 
SQL statements to determine anomalies 
. Participating in the research of global issues with other level II and level III groups, 
serving as the key analyst on Problem Management conference calls for the duration of 
the event, seeing it through to completion. Commendations have been received from 
level III teams that have been engaged for the high level of research performed. 
. Participate in a 24x7 rotating, oncall schedule

positions.title: Programmer / DBA
positions.description: Supported and developed applications in VC++ to improve the workflow of different business group. Administrated and supported an Informix database system and developed various Crystal Reports to provide a better context of the marketing and sales data available.
